script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Ana Frame
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.6, 0)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.2, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

-- Sürüklenebilirlik Fonksiyonu
local function makeDraggable(gui)
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local dragToggle = nil
    local dragSpeed = 0.25
    local dragStart = nil
    local startPos = nil

    local function updateInput(input)
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end

    gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragToggle = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = gui.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragToggle = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            if dragToggle then
                updateInput(input)
            end
        end
    end)
end

makeDraggable(mainFrame)

-- Başlık
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.1, 0)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
titleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
titleLabel.Text = "👾 OMER MOD MENU 👾"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
titleLabel.TextSize = 24
titleLabel.Parent = mainFrame

-- Buton Oluşturma Fonksiyonu
local function createButton(buttonName, positionY, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.08, 0)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, positionY, 0)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
    button.Text = buttonName
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    button.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    button.TextSize = 18
    button.Parent = mainFrame

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- 1. Sunucu Batırma
createButton("SUNUCU BATIRMA", 0.15, function()
    for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if not v:IsA("Terrain") and not game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(v) then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end

    game.Lighting.TimeOfDay = "18:00"
    for i = 1, 20 do
        local block = Instance.new("Part")
        block.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
        block.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-50, 50), 100, math.random(-50, 50))
        block.Anchored = true
        block.BrickColor = i % 2 == 0 and BrickColor.new("Really red") or BrickColor.Random()
        block.Parent = workspace
        wait(0.5)
    end
    wait(20)
    for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Part") and v.Position.Y > 50 then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end
end)

-- 2. Guest Hiper Şarjlı
createButton("GUEST HİPER ŞARJLI", 0.25, function()
    local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    char.HumanoidRootPart.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Royal purple")
    for _, child in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") then
            child.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Royal purple")
        end
    end

    local effect = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    effect.Texture = "rbxassetid://610877744"
    effect.Rate = 50
    effect.Parent = char.HumanoidRootPart
end)

-- 3. Guest Hile
createButton("GUEST HİLE", 0.35, function()
    local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 50

    local sword = Instance.new("Tool")
    sword.Name = "KILIÇ"
    sword.Parent = player.Backpack

    sword.Equipped:Connect(function()
        sword.Activated:Connect(function()
            local target = game.Players:GetPlayers()
            for _, plr in pairs(target) do
                if plr ~= player then
                    plr.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
end)

-- 4. Guest Menü
createButton("GUEST MENÜ", 0.45, function()
    -- Menü açılır (diskolar, müzik, vb. özellikleri içerir)
end)

-- 5. Disco
createButton("DİSKO", 0.55, function()
    -- Disco ışıkları eklenir
end)

-- 6. ALLAHU AKBAR
createButton("ALLAHU AKBAR", 0.65, function()
    -- Patlama ve hız eklenir
end)

-- 7. Eğitim Yap
createButton("EĞİTİM YAP", 0.75, function()
    -- Eğitim butonlarıyla bir menü oluşturulur
end)
